mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( review_no, member_no, product_no, order_item_no, title, content, rating, user_height, user_weight, size_rating, image_url ) VALUES ( seq_review.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{productNo}, #{orderItemNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{userHeight}, #{userWeight}, #{sizeRating}, #{imageUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT review_no, member_no, product_no, order_item_no, title, content, rating, user_height as userHeight, user_weight as userWeight, size_rating as sizeRating, image_url as imageUrl, like_count as likeCount, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, delete_yn as deleteYn FROM review WHERE product_no = #{productNo} AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT review_no as reviewNo, order_item_no as orderItemNo FROM review WHERE order_item_no = #{orderItemNo} AND delete_yn = 'N'
